name: Comprehensive_Inbound_Template
description:
This is a sample flow which shows how to use: business hours, menus, queuing, position in queue, callback, voicemail opt-out, screen pop, and basic error handling.

For more information, refer to the detailed guide:

https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n5595zd/Webex-Contact-Center-Setup-and-Administration-Guide#Cisco_Generic_Topic.dita_e338e055-64b0-4973-bd52-8a5581dcb0ee
